desc: The C1 Max is the latest addition to our Condition One Modular Mount lineup. The C1 Max was designed ground up with the precision rifle shooter in mind. Borrowing from and blending our Max 50 Scope Ring and C1 Modular Mount designs, the C1 Max has 1" wide, six screw ring caps for increased coverage and clamp force on your optic. The C1 Max also uses a low profile hardened steel clamp foot and four machined #10 crossbolts with low-pro T20 heads to ensure your mount stays put under the harshest recoil and conditions. The C1 Max has no forward cantilever for those who find cantilevered designs difficult to achieve eye relief with some optic and short action rail combos. The C1 Max is compatible with most of the full line of C1 accessories and attachments (there are specific ARC and ACD models for C1 Max) and offers the full range of modularity and customization the Condition One Modular Mounts are known for.
